catalogue_card.question: Which AI-agent skills are useful for marketing, and how can marketers use them?
catalogue_card.text: Match a source-inspected skill to a specific job and keep first use reviewable. Six entries remain, including conditional, draft-only emails; none was independently tested. Run 13 deferred a competitor messaging-change skill search because simple comparison methods and monitors remain credible alternatives. A page difference is not proof of a competitor strategy. Existing provenance and freshness limits remain.

summary: Run 13 defines a small, authorized comparison of dated prior and current captures for one known rival. Preserve exact source lines, URL, date, locale, view, currency and variant context. Missing baselines stop change claims.

Classify observed differences and potential noise separately. A source-visible change does not prove a strategic shift, effective price, launch date, market-wide rollout or business result; a named human checks materiality.

Saved diffs, versioned sheets, reviewed prompts and page monitors are credible alternatives. Vendor monitor descriptions are not independent reliability tests, and this run did not test a service or workflow.
Defer a package shortlist. The six catalogue entries and their caveats remain unchanged; no seventh card was added.
uncertainty: Practitioner accounts are self-selected and unverified, and some have commercial interests. No prevalence, time-savings, false-alert, controlled comparison or outcome evidence was established.

No trustworthy controlled public competitor-page before/after pair was established in this review. No page-monitor service was tested; vendor descriptions do not establish detection accuracy or permission to crawl.

The six packages were not rechecked. Four Superamped selected-file SHA/date and tag findings remain unresolved; emails lacks a selected-file pin and remains conditional/draft-only; Copywriting’s dated record is not a current-branch pin; Run 7 did not verify current-day selected-directory listings.
